pacing_fluency.description: Speech rate stability, cadence, and absence of erratic rushes or sluggishness

pause_management.description: Natural pause placement, absence of extended dead-air and hesitation blocks

vocal_energy_clarity.description: Dynamic range, vocal projection, and stability of RMS energy contours

pitch_expressiveness.description: Pitch variation, avoidance of monotonic delivery or erratic vocal fry/cracks

emphasis_consistency.description: Spectral contrast alignment with baseline rhetorical focal points
